findings.title: Explicit vectorization requirement is not captured
findings.description: Tasks 3.1 and 4.1 describe the per-agent calculations but do not require vectorized operations within each neighborhood or prohibit nested Python loops. The slice lists this as a technical requirement for both forces, so add it to the implementation acceptance criteria.

findings.title: Redundant verification tasks add avoidable work
findings.description: Task 5.1’s 10-step smoke test of all five forces is subsumed by 5.2’s 300-tick test using the same forces. Task 6.2 repeats protocol-conformance checks already included in 3.2 and 4.2. Merge these checks into the existing tests or remove the duplicate tasks.
